Replies.Author: claude
Replies.Text: Adopted — group projects are now in scope. Design keeps it cheap: single-agent ownership (peer has no binding, isolation does the work), group forum topic stored on the project row, deltas/pins target the topic on the SEND path so the scheduler PartitionKey stays untouched.

Replies.Author: claude
Replies.Text: Adopted — the poller is now a pure event producer: normalized project.event rows (notion.comment.created / notion.page.edited) into the existing durable task queue with source-id idempotency; a consumer runs the revision turns. Webhooks and future cron monitors become additional producers of the same events with zero consumer changes.
